name: curate-golden
description: Small, realistic 16-asset stash (agent, commands, knowledge, memories, scripts, skills) plus a hand-labeled judgments.json ground truth, used as the frozen corpus for the curate ranking effectiveness gate.
purpose: ORG-08: the fixture existed and was already consumed by tests/integration/curate-golden-eval.test.ts (which fs.cpSync's the whole directory directly), but had no MANIFEST.json, so listFixtures() (tests/fixtures/stashes/load.ts) silently omitted it from the 5-fixture set. Adding this manifest makes listFixtures() report all five shipped fixtures.
notes: judgments.json (schemaVersion 1, corpus "curate-golden") is NOT a stash asset — it is hand-labeled relevance ground truth (relevant / idealOrder / banned refs per query) consumed directly by curate-golden-eval.test.ts, which removes it from the materialised copy before indexing so it never becomes an indexable entry.
